text:
Situation: Piperacillin and tazobactam is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-01-20. Current inventory across Corvale sites provides between 17.9 and 25.1 days on hand for the 2 g + 0.25 g and 36 g/180 mL presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include piperacillin and tazobactam as of 2026-10-21. Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) received an OAI classification on 2025-09-05 per FDA inspection 1286862. Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) received a VAI classification on 2019-03-01 per FDA inspection 1081040.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but the Fresenius Kabi discontinuation removes one manufacturer. No FDA shortage listing exists. We should secure alternative sources now to prevent future gaps.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, and BluePoint Laboratories — none on FDA's shortage list today; labels name no plant we could place. Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to P&T committee. Requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
